assessment: This is a fundamental work that significantly advances our understanding of the role of mossy cells in the dentate gyrus in fragile X syndrome. The carefully designed and executed extensive series of experiments provide compelling evidence that changes in their excitability occur due to upregulation of Kv7 currents. The study unveils the underlying mechanisms of the disease, and therefore the work will be of interest to neuroscientists working on various aspects of fragile X pathology. In addition, it also provides insights into how neuronal activity is balanced in networks through diverse cellular mechanisms.
